## TENANT A — E-commerce SMB

### New Order
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook/oem-event-router-v2 \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"tenant_a","event_type":"new_order","payload":{"customer_email":"anna@shop.com","cart_value":120.00}}'

### Cart Abandoned
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook/oem-event-router-v2 \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"tenant_a","event_type":"cart_abandoned","payload":{"customer_email":"anna@shop.com","cart_value":89.99}}'

### Refund Requested
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook/oem-event-router-v2 \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"tenant_a","event_type":"refund_requested","payload":{"customer_email":"anna@shop.com","cart_value":45.00}}'

## TENANT B — B2B SaaS

### Trial Signup
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook/oem-event-router-v2 \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"tenant_b","event_type":"trial_signup","payload":{"customer_email":"john@acme.com","company":"Acme Corp","plan":"trial"}}'

### Upgrade
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook/oem-event-router-v2 \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"tenant_b","event_type":"upgrade","payload":{"customer_email":"john@acme.com","company":"Acme Corp","plan":"pro"}}'

### Churn Signal
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook/oem-event-router-v2 \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"tenant_b","event_type":"churn_signal","payload":{"customer_email":"john@acme.com","company":"Acme Corp","usage_drop":"78%"}}'
